hunt.ask: Find 20 APAC manufacturing companies expanding plants this quarter
hunt.matchedAsk: Find 20 APAC manufacturing companies expanding plants this quarter
hunt.you: You asked: Find 20 APAC manufacturing companies expanding plants this quarter
hunt.agent: Ranked 20 fictional APAC manufacturers with a plant expansion dated this quarter.
hunt.why: A company is on the list only when the notice names a plant, the date is this quarter, and the sector is manufacturing. The fit score is that rank. Kestrel Forge is first because the Hai Phong hall is already breaking ground and the buyer is named.

trace.line: Read 20 plant-expansion notices filed this quarter.
Scored each notice for a named plant, a date this quarter, and a manufacturing sector.
Ranked 20 accounts. Highest fit is 96, Kestrel Forge. Lowest fit is 58, Cinderpath Tools.

badges.you: You used the sample badge scan.

badges.why: A row is junk when it is blank, a test scan, a printer, a walk-in, or an unreadable email. Repeat scans of the same person collapse to one row. Hot means a senior title, a real email, and a company on the expansion list.
